description: Build, Deploy, and Documentation - Dockerfile (multi-stage), docker-compose.yml, complete Makefile, .gitignore, and final verification that go build/vet/test and frontend tsc/build all pass cleanly
steps: Create Dockerfile: Multi-stage build. Stage 1 (frontend): node:22-alpine, copy ui/, npm ci, npm run build. Stage 2 (backend): golang:1.25-alpine, copy go.mod/go.sum, go mod download, copy all source + ui/dist from stage 1, go build -o /app cmd/server/main.go. Stage 3 (runtime): alpine:latest, copy binary, expose port 8080, ENTRYPOINT ["/app"].

Create docker-compose.yml: services for app (build ., ports 8080, env vars from .env, depends_on postgres), postgres (image postgres:16-alpine, volumes, environment for POSTGRES_USER/PASSWORD/DB), optional: adminer for DB management.

Update Makefile to be comprehensive: build (builds Go binary with embedded frontend), run, test (go test ./... -v), dev (concurrent), lint (go vet + golangci-lint run if available), clean, docker-build, docker-run, docker-compose-up, migrate, seed, frontend-build, frontend-dev.
Create .gitignore: Go binaries, ui/node_modules, ui/dist, .env, data/ (sqlite files), tmp/, vendor/ (if used), .DS_Store, *.exe.
Add basic Go tests: Create internal/config/config_test.go testing config loading. Create internal/database/factory_test.go testing URL scheme detection. These should pass with go test ./...
Run final verification: go build ./..., go vet ./..., go test ./..., cd ui && npx tsc --noEmit, cd ui && npm run build. All must exit 0 with zero errors and zero warnings.
Fix any compilation errors, type errors, or test failures found during verification.
acceptance_criteria: go test ./... exits with code 0 with all tests passing
cd ui && npx tsc --noEmit exits with code 0
cd ui && npm run build exits with code 0
docker-compose.yml exists with app + postgres services
